Lina (partner-eng): Heads-up: partner asks us to formalize a rollback + hotfix flow for ROCm 6.0 / driver pins in marketplace images. They hit a perf regression last week on quant workloads. Can we draft a short playbook for partners and list required artifacts?

Atsu (hw-eng): Sorry to hear that. For kernel-level regressions we need kernel logs + nvprof traces + exact driver package. Minimum ask: signed artifact, SHA256, and a reproducible repro that hits the regression within 2 minutes on a small input.

Diego (solutions): We should expose a metadata field in the marketplace manifest: `compatibility: {archives: [rocm-6.0, rocm-5.x], fallback_images: [...]}` so the runtime can choose fallback images when health checks fail. I'll sketch a JSON schema for manifest.

Rina (platform-ops): From platform side we can add a health-check hook executed at startup + periodic perf probe (p90 latency on a tiny prompt). Canary rollout plan: 10% -> 30% -> 100% with automated pause on any of: >1.5x error-rate, perf degradation >20%, or kernel oops in syslog. Logs shipped to S3: `s3://redwood-marketplace/canaries/rocm6/` for partner debugging.

marketplace-bot: Event: Partner debrief meeting scheduled 2026-05-04 09:30 UTC — https://calendar.redwood.ai/ev/67890

Atsu (hw-eng): We'll need a validation matrix across our 4 SKUs. Proposal: partner provides hotfix tarball to `s3://redwood-partner-hotfixes/atsu/` and we provide a signed manifest template. Also recommend a staged kernel module test run and a fallback driver image pinned to `rocm-5.4.3` for immediate rollback.

Lina (partner-eng): Good. Can we publish a small partner-facing checklist: what to include in the bundle, how to sign manifests, expected turnaround times for validation? Partners will want SLAs for hotfix acceptance.

Diego (solutions): I'll create a CI job `marketplace:rocm_compat_matrix` that runs smoke, perf-check, and quant regression tests. Sample runtime override for partners:

```
REDWOOD_RUNTIME_DRIVER_FALLBACK=true \
REDWOOD_DRIVER_PIN=rocm-5.4.3 \
--image=redwood/marketplace:rocm6-canary-20260504
```

This will instruct the runtime to prefer pinned fallback if health probes fail.

Rina (platform-ops): Ops checklist: update release gates to require green `kernel-smoke` and `quant-smoke` jobs before promoting from canary to soft-deprecate. Retain canary traces for 7 days by default, add partner email to alerting on spike. We'll also keep a phone tree for SEV escalations.

Atsu (hw-eng): Timeline: we can start partner validation week May 11-15. Please confirm earliest image push by May 8 so we can schedule SKU runs.

Lina (partner-eng): Confirmed — I'll ask partner to upload artifacts by May 6. I'll draft the one-pager: checklist + expected timeline + contacts + how to opt into `legacy-driver` tag if needed.

Diego (solutions): After validation I'll publish the manifest example and CI link in the meeting notes. Also adding a note: if fallback image used, Console should flag run as `using-compat-fallback` for visibility.

Lina (partner-eng): Thanks all — I'll share draft playbook EOD. If no objections we'll present to partner on May 4 call. :white_check_mark:
